authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No Oracle/Consultation or Breach cEDH shell (blueprint L53).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Opponents' copies can backfire, e.g. a copied tutor or wipe.
mitigations: 'up to one' lets you give none

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Five-mana commander plus five- to seven-mana copy engines.
Counters on the key copy spell break the combos.

value.interaction: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Narset's Reversal, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Chaos Warp, Feed the Swarm, Blasphemous Act.
value.mana: 35 lands, nine fetches, Sol Ring, Dark Ritual, Signets/Talismans.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Parnesse protects herself and your permanents with a 4-life targeting tax, and her copy-sharing is a political tool.
accepted_role.honest_note: None of the 25 Spellbook infinites in the list uses Parnesse; all are copy-spell pairs that work in any Grixis spellslinger deck. Her second ability gives opponents copies, which is optional politics and can be a liability. The source frames the deck as political conversion (blueprint L12), but mechanically she's a five-mana protection/politics commander on top of a strong generic copy-combo shell. The calibration floor is 3, below the source's 4; the 25 two-card infinites support 4. M1 review (parnesse-01..10) flags Bonus Round as symmetric (parnesse-07) and leaves one question uncertain (parnesse-10: whether opponents' retargeted copies pay her 4-life tax).
